summary: Fireworks AI's official pricing page states: "Pay per token, with high rate limits and postpaid billing. Get started with $1 in free credits." This matches the claimed $1 starter credit for new accounts. The page's "Get Started" button links to /signup, so claiming requires creating an account. No expiry or limited-time language appears near the offer, so it is treated as ongoing with no fixed end date. The offer was not personally redeemed; the verdict is based on the official page.
claim_steps: Go to https://fireworks.ai/pricing, which states: "Get started with $1 in free credits."
Click the "Get Started" button, which links to https://fireworks.ai/signup.
Create a new Fireworks AI account.
Use the $1 in free credits with pay-per-token serverless inference (Standard, Priority, or Fast tiers).
